competitive_landscape: Azam Marine runs the only scheduled passenger ferry to Pemba; charter dive-boats handle the rest. No electric / foiling tier exists. Coastal Aviation and ZanAir cover the air spokes. The premium-resort transfer tier is wide open.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the entire Pemba lattice — Stone Town↔Mkoani (~50 nm), Karume↔Manta Resort (~25 nm), Chake-Chake↔Misali MPA (~4 nm) — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on protected lee water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Hybrid Quanta-LR is the longer-horizon East Africa coastal trunk — Pemba↔Mombasa (~80 nm) — with no charging-infrastructure dependency.

precedents.why_it_matters: Stone Town↔Mkoani is the cleanest extension of the built Zanzibar node northward — closes the Tanzanian island spine.

regulatory_note: Zanzibar (Tanzania's semi-autonomous archipelago) regulates Pemba water transport through the Zanzibar Maritime Authority. Pemba Channel Conservation Area and Misali Island Marine Conservation Area give a clean quiet-mode regulatory anchor. Tanzanian MARPOL implementation applies.
seasonality: Year-round; the Pemba Channel sees kusi SE-monsoon chop June–September that foiling handles materially better than open dive-boats. NE monsoon December–March is gentler.

summary: Pemba Island is the quieter luxury-diving island ~30 nm north of Zanzibar, anchored by The Manta Resort and a small cluster of dive-led hospitality. Protected lee-side channels and short hops fit the luxury island-hopping archetype; year-round commuter volume is thinner than Zanzibar but the Zanzibar–Pemba link closes the northern Tanzanian spine and is the cleanest premium-resort spoke off the built Zanzibar node.
tagline: Tanzania's luxury-diving island — short protected hops complete the northern Zanzibar spine.
